title: 展开
summary: 多出来的内容先问撑开文档流还是盖一层。互斥还是独立，是流里的第二问。不要把抽屉再做一遍。
summaryEn: Extra content first asks whether it pushes the document flow or covers it. Exclusive versus independent is the second question inside the flow. Do not rebuild the drawer.
asks: 这块多出来的内容，是撑开文档流，还是盖一层？
asksEn: Does the extra content push the document flow, or cover it with a new layer?

links.when: 流内撑开不是侧滑抽屉
links.whenEn: pushing the document flow is not a sliding drawer

links.when: FAQ 手风琴不是列宽画廊
links.whenEn: a FAQ accordion is not a column-width gallery

links.when: 内容树不是主导航多级
links.whenEn: a content tree is not primary-nav multilevel

links.when: 若是列表变长而不是一块面板开合
links.whenEn: if the list grows rather than a panel opening
